name: Cardiac conduction system development and gap junction coupling
rationale: Members cover development of the SA node, AV node and His-Purkinje system plus gap-junction electrical coupling in cardiac conduction; confusables instead hold action-potential depolarization and channel members, not conduction-system development.

name: Neural immunoglobulin-superfamily adhesion and netrin-guided axon extension
rationale: Members are L1/CHL1, DSCAM and SDK adhesion-molecule signalling, dendrite self-avoidance and netrin-driven axon extension; confusables are ephrin, semaphorin or Slit repulsion and synapse-adhesion themes lacking the L1/DSCAM/SDK members.

core: Inhibition of striated muscle ion transport
qualifier: calcium pump and membrane ion flux
name: Inhibition of striated muscle calcium pump and membrane ion flux
rationale: Members negatively regulate plasma-membrane calcium and potassium transport, action potentials and ATPase-coupled calcium uptake into sarcoplasmic reticulum in striated muscle; confusables centre on ryanodine-mediated release, cardiac contraction or repolarizing potassium channels.

qualifier: synthesis, transport and lysosomal hexosaminidase catabolism
name: Glycosphingolipid synthesis, transport and lysosomal hexosaminidase catabolism
rationale: Members span ganglioside and galactosylceramide synthesis, glycolipid transport and lysosomal glycosphingolipid breakdown including HEXA/HEXB and glucosamine-containing compound catabolism; confusables are GPI-anchor, sialic-acid/N-glycan or non-glycosylated sphingolipid themes.

name: Reelin signaling in dendrite and spine maintenance
rationale: Members are Reelin signalling with regulation of dendrite development, dendritic spine and postsynaptic membrane maintenance; confusables share the spine-maintenance terms but lack Reelin, carrying microglial or synaptic-plasticity members instead.

name: Peroxisome biogenesis, protein import and pexophagy
rationale: Members are peroxisomal matrix and membrane protein import, fission, TYSND1 processing and peroxisome autophagy; confusables are peroxisomal fatty-acid oxidation and lipid synthesis themes.

name: Leukotriene and lipoxin metabolism with eicosanoid receptor signaling
rationale: Members cover lipoxygenase-derived leukotriene, lipoxin and HETE synthesis and catabolism plus leukotriene and prostanoid receptor signalling; confusables add pro-resolving mediators or P450 epoxygenase/omega-hydroxylase products and lack the receptor members.

name: Post-lanosterol cholesterol biosynthesis via Bloch and Kandutsch-Russell branches
rationale: All members are the late sterol steps from zymosterol via desmosterol or lathosterol to cholesterol; confusables cover the upstream mevalonate/lanosterol and dolichol steps, bile-acid synthesis or peroxisomal fatty-acid metabolism.

name: Cation-chloride cotransporters and renal sodium-potassium transport
rationale: Members are SLC12 cotransporters and their Bartter/Gitelman/ACCPN defects, potassium channels and regulation of renal sodium and potassium transport; confusables emphasise osmotic responses, sodium/proton exchangers, vasopressin-aquaporin water handling or magnesium transport.

name: RIG-I-like receptor RNA sensing with feedback regulation
rationale: Members are RIG-I/MDA5 cytosolic dsRNA sensing to IRF3 and NF-kB plus positive and negative regulators of the pathway; confusables cover TBK1/IRF3, cGAS-STING, TLR or interferon-production themes lacking the negative regulation of RIG-I.

name: CSF1 and GM-CSF signaling in monocyte-macrophage differentiation
rationale: Members are M-CSF and GM-CSF signalling with monocyte, macrophage and myeloid dendritic cell differentiation; confusables are osteoclast fusion, granulopoiesis or DAP12/SIRP themes.

qualifier: ganglioside synthesis, transport and lysosomal catabolism
name: Glycosphingolipid and ganglioside synthesis, transport and lysosomal catabolism
rationale: Members are glycosphingolipid and ganglioside synthesis, glycolipid transport and lysosomal degradation including GM2 gangliosidoses and sialidosis; confusables are plain sphingomyelin/ceramide metabolism, broad glycosylation, or a lysosome-transport set lacking the synthesis and catabolism members.

qualifier: mast cell and colony-stimulating factor driven
name: Granulocyte and mast cell differentiation via colony-stimulating factors
rationale: Members are neutrophil, eosinophil and mast cell differentiation with G-CSF and GM-CSF signalling; confusables are monocyte/M-CSF or general myeloid progenitor themes lacking eosinophil and mast cell differentiation.

name: TRAIL and Fas death receptor caspase-8 apoptotic signaling
rationale: Members are TRAIL and FasL signalling, procaspase-8 dimerization, c-FLIP inhibition and BID activation; confusables are necroptosis, TLR3/TRIF cell death or intrinsic mitochondrial apoptosis themes.

name: Cortical and forebrain neuron migration, lamination and specification
rationale: Members are radial and tangential neuron migration, cortical layering and regionalization, interneuron migration and forebrain neuron-type commitment; confusables are spinal cord patterning or commissure/axon-tract morphogenesis themes.

name: G2/M checkpoint recovery via p53 and Cdc25A regulation
rationale: Members are Cdc25A and p53 degradation, p53 phosphorylation, COP1, GTSE1 and MASTL control of G2/M progression; confusables carry DNA-damage checkpoint signalling, CDK dephosphorylation or G1/S RB-E2F members.

name: Cyclic nucleotide signaling promoting natriuresis and diuresis
rationale: Members are cGMP synthesis and receptor guanylyl cyclase signalling, cellular responses to cAMP and cGMP, and renal sodium excretion and urine volume; confusables are renin-angiotensin or vascular blood-pressure themes lacking the cyclic-nucleotide responses.

qualifier: with IGF response in growth and lifespan
name: Growth hormone and IGF signaling in growth and lifespan
rationale: Members are GH receptor JAK-STAT signalling, GH secretion, IGF responses, growth rate and lifespan; confusables are leptin, prolactin, thyroid or glucagon/somatostatin hormone themes lacking the IGF members.

name: Fibroblast stromal secretory programme with TGF-beta1 production control
rationale: Members are stromal/fibroblast matrix, complement and chemokine expression modules, fibroblast proliferation, adhesion and regulation of TGF-beta1 production; confusables are endothelial-perivascular, core collagen-integrin ECM or YAP/TAZ mechanoresponsive themes.

name: Nuclear exosome 3'-5' RNA processing and surveillance decay
rationale: Members are 3'-to-5' exonucleolytic trimming and decay of rRNA, snRNA, snoRNA, tRNA, CUTs and mRNA in nuclear surveillance; confusables are snoRNP/Cajal body, spliceosome, cytoplasmic NMD/ribosome rescue or endonucleolytic rRNA processing.

qualifier: NRF2, FOXO and p53 with redox metabolism
name: NRF2, FOXO and p53 stress transcription with redox metabolism
rationale: Members are NRF2 target programmes, AKT-regulated FOXO transcription, p53 and mTORC1 hallmarks and regulation of pentose-phosphate and glycolytic flux; confusables are hypoxia/HIF glycolysis or ER-stress UPR themes.

name: Endosome-Golgi retrograde transport and endocytic recycling
rationale: Members are endosome-to-Golgi retrograde and Golgi-to-endosome transport, receptor and endocytic recycling to the plasma membrane and Golgi retention; confusables are Golgi organization, COPI budding or lysosome-vesicle biogenesis themes.

name: Calcineurin-NFAT signaling in cardiomyocyte growth and hypertrophy
rationale: Members are calcineurin-NFAT activation and its regulation with cardiac muscle adaptation, cell size and sarcomere growth; confusables cover cardiac contractility, skeletal muscle atrophy or regeneration without calcineurin members.

qualifier: erythrocyte gas and ammonium transport with lung surfactant
name: Erythrocyte gas and ammonium transport with pulmonary surfactant homeostasis
rationale: Members are erythrocyte O2/CO2 exchange, Rh glycoprotein ammonium transport and surfactant metabolism with its disease defects; confusables lack either the surfactant members (heme/iron, lactate transport) or the Rh/gas transport members (lung development).

name: CDP-pathway glycerophospholipid and cardiolipin biosynthesis
rationale: Members are de novo synthesis of PC, PE, PS, PG and cardiolipin via CDP-choline and CDP-diacylglycerol, plus cardiolipin/PG remodeling; confusables are phospholipid catabolism and transfer, PA/triglyceride synthesis, or general acyl-chain remodeling.
